about.en: SushiSwap is a decentralized exchange and automated market maker deployed across 40+ blockchains, offering swaps, liquidity provision, cross-chain swaps, and yield farming under community governance.
about.es: SushiSwap es un exchange descentralizado y automated market maker desplegado en mas de 40 blockchains, que ofrece swaps, provision de liquidez, swaps cross-chain y yield farming bajo gobernanza comunitaria.
about.ca: SushiSwap es un exchange descentralitzat i automated market maker desplegat en mes de 40 blockchains, que ofereix swaps, provisio de liquiditat, swaps cross-chain i yield farming sota governanca comunitaria.
